motivation: MAT01 observed shared r4 source subspace underfit heldout digit input corruptions. Is native LoRA rank4 quality recoverable with a little truly private target-specific rank2 capacity + a short Mirror code, at lower physical bytes and a gain over same-byte ordinary linear codes?
scope: New CPU synthetic/real digits adapter bank with heldout corruptions; distinct seeded splits from MAT01. This is an independent follow-up; no modification of prior MAT01 outcomes and does not reproduce native LoGo.
frozen_source: Reuse unchanged MAT01 implementation for preprocessing, 320-step base, six 145-step source rank4 LoRAs, source-only U/V r4 and C0; add per-task private low-rank residual to target-code training.

splits.note: same sklearn digit dataset across seeds, repeated data partitions correlated; not 5 independent natural task datasets

methods.native_lora4: Native independent rank4 A(64x4)B(4x10), 296 trainable scalars/role
methods.native_lora2: Native independent rank2 A(64x2)B(2x10), 148 trainable scalars/role
methods.mirror4: Source-only U(64x4), V(4x10), C0(4x4), target 4 Givens angles, no private
methods.linear4: Source-only U,V,C0, source-code linear 4x4x4 dictionary, target 4 coefficients, no private
methods.mirror4_private2: U @ Q(m) C0 Q(m)^T @ V plus independent target-specific rank2 A_j B_j, optimize m,A,B jointly
methods.linear4_private2: U @ (C0+sum c_j[k] D_source[k]) @ V plus identical target rank2 A_j B_j, optimize code,A,B jointly
methods.fullcore16_private1: U @ (C0+16 target core scalars) @ V plus rank1 A_j B_j, optimize core and private jointly

training.code_initialization: zero/small rotation, private A random 0.02 and private B exactly zero

metrics: fresh task NLL nat/example and accuracy for all 4 roles
full physically serialized named NPZ including shared base, source U/V/C0 plus paid dictionary and all private parameters
actual CPU B128 four output P50/P95 in ms, 20 warmup,100 repeats, one BLAS thread
difference to strongest same-code linear4+private2 and to cheap independent private-only rank2
worst role and per-world paired improvement

gates.PASS_MECHANISM: on 4/5 fresh heldout splits, mirror+private2 NLL <= native LoRA4 NLL+0.05 nat/example, full serialized bytes <=85% native LoRA4, <=1.10x native LoRA4 P95; additionally beats simple ordinary linear4+private2 NLL by >=0.01 to count incremental Mirror benefit. Otherwise M0/FAIL.
gates.FAIL: mirror+private2 fails the native quality or same-byte lowrank residual/linear controls dominate, and no narrow evidence of Mirror-specific gain
gates.UNCERTAIN: dataset split correlation, limited 5-world sample, native LoGo not reproduced, real GPU absent; preserve diagnostics and source-only model claims

limitations: Fresh sets 201..205 must not select ranks or adjust learning steps; any new code must be frozen in repo before fresh evaluation.
Never conclude LOra/source adapter equivalence by Frobenius; score functional heldout CE and worst role.
Per-task target private trainable residual is a genuinely private paid object; do not count it as shared/mirror compression.
hardware: CPU PyTorch2.10+cpu, NumPy2.3.5, sklearn1.8, 1 thread, FP32
